bio.text: Zoe Lofgren has been a member of the U.S. House of Representatives since 1995 and represents California's 18th District, covering parts of Monterey, San Benito, Santa Clara, and Santa Cruz counties.
She served on the Santa Clara County Board of Supervisors for 14 years after her 1980 election, and earlier on the San Jose Evergreen Community College Board.
She graduated from Stanford University in 1970 and from Santa Clara University School of Law in 1975, and practiced and taught immigration law.
